messages:
Ravi (Product): Heads-up: FinGate wants enterprise controls: BYOK across hosted + private, per-tenant retention up to 7 years, and auditor-ready evidence packages. They need concrete acceptance criteria for our contract.

Claire (Sales): High priority deal. They expect a price for storage + export. Also asked for an API to trigger exports so their compliance team can automate.

Mina (Security): Minimum security needs: CMEK support (AWS/GCP/Azure), signed export manifests, and a record of key access. For immutable proof, we can generate a Merkle root per export and sign it.

Diego (Eng): Quick notes:
- Storage model: compressed chunked logs (daily objects) with lifecycle transitions to cold blob storage.
- Retention config: tenant-level settings (90d, 2yr, 5yr, 7yr).
- Export: batch job -> tar.gz with logs + manifest.json + merkle.sig. Exports may take hours for multi-TB exports.

Zoe (Legal): Must include chain-of-custody: who requested, approver, hashes, signer identity, and a timestamp. 5 business days SLA for standard exports seems reasonable. Need legal-hold flow documented.

Claire (Sales): We should segment offering: hosted customers get up to 2yr, enterprise plans for 5-7yr with surcharge. Also add expedited export for a fee.

Mina (Security): Edge case: customer rotates their KMS keys. Plan: use a DEK per time epoch wrapped by the customer's KMS and store wrapped DEKs so we can decrypt historical logs. That requires retention of wrapped keys and strict access audit.

Diego (Eng): Rough estimate: dev 6-9w for MVP backend + infra capacity for cold storage. Need storage cost model and export bandwidth pricing.

Ravi (Product): Draft acceptance criteria: (1) CMEK support for hosted + private, (2) per-tenant retention config up to 7yr, (3) exportable evidence package with signed manifest and Merkle root, (4) audit trail + legal-hold, (5) pricing proposal for archival storage and export.

infra-bot: Created task PROD-4410 "Enterprise retention + export scoping" assigned to @Diego, @Mina, @Ravi. Due in 7 days.

Ravi (Product): Actions: Diego -> cost + prototype export runner (EOW). Mina -> security design for Merkle + wrapped DEKs (EOW). Zoe -> export artifact checklist + SLA language (Tue). Claire -> customer pricing buckets and top accounts (Fri). We'll reconvene after deliverables.
